lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah that Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon is coming to strike Egypt, and the news is announced in Migdol.
The LORD has thrust Egypt's warriors down, and they say Pharaoh was all noise and let his appointed time pass.
The LORD tells the daughter dwelling in Egypt to pack for exile, and says a lion from the north is coming against Egypt.
The LORD will punish Amon god of Zoan and Pharaoh, delivering them to Nebuchadnezzar and his officers, but Egypt will later be inhabited again.
The LORD tells Jacob not to be afraid, because He is with him and will discipline him justly.
